AVIATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

3. When learning Aviation Security, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Security.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Security.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Security.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Security.

4. When learning Career Opportunities in Aviation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
